children: Horizen's L3 network stops processing transactions on 5 November 2026 at 18:00 UTC as Base's Denim upgrade activates. The network shutdown makes Base the new home chain for the Horizen ecosystem.
The L3 shutdown is permanent. Base will also be the home chain for ZEN staking and nodes, as well as the upcoming privacy products that Horizen plans to introduce.
TLDR: Horizen is changing. The Horizen L3 is winding down over the next two weeks.
